svg.title: Where TrnRT stands
svg.desc: Total tokens per dollar on InferenceX AgentX, one TrnRT engine (8 Trainium2 chips) against one 8-GPU node, at AWS Capacity Block prices: 1.6 to 1.75 times H200's at 1 to 8 users, 1.34 times at 12 users and 1.07 times at 16, and 3.5 to 5.2 times H100's at 12 to 32 users
